manifest_inventory.unrequested_dependencies: Inventoried but no target/latest-major claim made because the requested scope names explicit packages and network registry lookup was not part of this analysis stage. Compatibility of transitive and adjacent webpack/Vue plugins remains a planning obligation.

breaking_changes: Hapi 16 to @hapi/hapi 21 replaces app.connection and callback lifecycle with constructor options and promises.
request is synchronously invoked through wait.for; Axios 1 is promise-based, so async control flow must propagate through server handlers/service methods.
Webpack 5 removes NamedModulesPlugin and automatic Node polyfills; webpack-dev-server 5 rejects many current devServer keys and CLI flags.
ExtractTextPlugin, eslint-loader, file-loader/url-loader-era patterns and old HtmlWebpackPlugin/plugin versions must be aligned with webpack 5.
Gulp 4 removes dependency arrays and requires explicit series/parallel task composition.
BootstrapVue 2 targets Bootstrap 4; Bootstrap 5 cannot be adopted while retaining the current b-* components without an alternate compatibility strategy.
There is no package lockfile, making reproducible installation and transitive compatibility/security verification impossible until one is generated.
CI and scripts assume Node 6, Ubuntu Trusty, old Firefox/geckodriver, Unix shell syntax, and deprecated webpack flags.
Known-checklist scans found no async .drain assignment, Express route/query hazard, Socket.IO client/server boundary, or uglify-js filename-array minify call in committed JavaScript.
notes: The committed source supports the requested interim Vue 2.7 direction; a Vue 3 rewrite would expand scope across global registration, router construction, plugins, and every BootstrapVue component.
Start runs from repository root, listens on localhost:8080 by default, and Behave targets http://localhost:8080.
make test maps to Node invocations for tests/apitest.js, tests/class-info-test.js, and tests/phenopacket-test.js with NODE_PATH set.
npm run wbs-lint currently references wbs.eslintrc and wpsrc, neither of which is present in HEAD, so the requested lint command is already structurally broken and needs planning attention.

coverage_notes: GitNexus preflight reported 0 indexed files, 0 symbols, and 0 relationships; graph-assisted call/impact analysis was unavailable, so coverage is reduced to committed-tree manifest/config inspection and git grep line searches.

The target worktree has nearly every tracked application file staged as deleted. Analysis preserved that state and read HEAD objects via git show/git grep. Build, start, lint, tests, and later edits cannot proceed safely in this worktree until the orchestrator/user restores or recreates the application files.
Repository ownership is considered dubious by Git for the current process identity; read-only commands used a per-command safe.directory setting without changing global configuration.
No package-lock.json, npm-shrinkwrap.json, yarn.lock, or pnpm lockfile exists in HEAD; exact resolved/transitive versions are unknown.

External service versions are not declared. SciGraph ontology/data, Solr/GOlr, OwlSim, Biolink API, and Blogger RSS are checked-in live endpoints and require live compatibility/availability verification.

Dependency usage searches covered all committed .js and .vue require/import sites for requested packages. Bootstrap CSS class-level usage is extensive and was represented by the entry import and BootstrapVue component boundaries rather than enumerating every markup class.
Feature files were treated as whole-file validation artifacts because the worktree copies are absent; exact scenarios remain available in HEAD but were not required to locate dependency boundaries.
No excluded paths were supplied. Generated/cache data was not used as upgrade evidence except to avoid noisy false positives during service scanning.
